headline: The 203-second DAON LAB session addressed 41 comments and corrected all three compliance and fact alerts in 8 seconds.
highlights: All 3 required points for Hydra Barrier Cream were covered during its presentation.
The compliance alert and both factual alerts regarding price and niacinamide percentage were corrected within 8,000 milliseconds.
AI, host, and brand replies successfully addressed question groups across both featured products.
watch_outs: Deep Hydration Ampoule ran for only 37 seconds out of 600 planned seconds and missed 2 required points.
A high-severity ASEAN compliance alert was triggered for claiming wrinkles would disappear overnight.
Seven question groups across the products and shipping remained unanswered.
follow_ups: Reply to the 3 unanswered question groups for Hydra Barrier Cream, including use under makeup, dry skin suitability, and use by children with eczema.
Reply to the 3 unanswered question groups for Deep Hydration Ampoule regarding skin stinging, morning use, and compatibility with vitamin C.
Respond to the unanswered shipping inquiry regarding delivery to Malaysia.
Ensure the 2 missed required points for Deep Hydration Ampoule regarding instant hydration and patch testing are covered in future broadcasts.
